name: Flooded Circuit · Arcane
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 9-block radius for 15 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning + 3 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 16.5 s
• Knockback
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 12 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 4.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Arcane instability: −0.75 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
